def find_max(a, b):
    """
    This function takes two numbers as input and returns the maximum of the two.
    """
    return a if a > b else b

def test_find_max():
    """
    This function contains unit tests for the find_max function.
    """
    assert find_max(10, 20) == 20, "Test case 1 failed"
    assert find_max(-5, -10) == -5, "Test case 2 failed"
    assert find_max(0, 0) == 0, "Test case 3 failed"
    assert find_max(100, 50) == 100, "Test case 4 failed"
    assert find_max(3.5, 2.5) == 3.5, "Test case 5 failed"
    print("All test cases passed!")

# Execute the test function when the script is run
if __name__ == "__main__":
    test_find_max()
```
